This binding may modulate the activity of Kcnk6, potentially influencing the function of Kcnk1, which is a component of the twik structure. The interaction between Ibutilide and Kcnk6, in turn, could alter the functional state of Kcnk1, suggesting a regulatory role for Ibutilide in the expression or activity of Kcnk1. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential mechanism by which Ibutilide exerts its effects on Kcnk1, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
